surprises.head: Anaheim won without the better chances
surprises.body: Expected goals favoured Vegas, 3.2 to 2.7, with empty nets left out.

surprises.head: Vegas tried a different line
surprises.body: I. Barbashev, M. Marner, W. Karlsson played 6:01 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Vegas’s usual lines.
